name: Managed IT Service Operations
audience: small managed service providers and multi-client IT support teams
topic: access, recurring evidence, and escalation workflows for MSPs

products.name: Client Access Request Gate
products.product: A focused MSP client access request approval workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small managed service providers and multi-client IT support teams
products.problem: Access changes arrive through tickets, email, and chat without consistent requester validation, client approval, scope, or proof that the change was completed and reviewed.
products.valueProposition: Turns MSP client access request approval into a visible operating queue so every client access change is authorized by the right person, implemented to the approved scope, and evidenced in the client record.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets MSP access request workflow, client user access approval, IT access request template, and managed service provider onboarding access searches.

products.name: Maintenance Evidence Runbook
products.product: A focused MSP recurring maintenance evidence tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small managed service providers and multi-client IT support teams
products.problem: Recurring maintenance can show as completed in a task list even when scripts partially fail, devices are excluded, or client-facing evidence is never attached.
products.valueProposition: Turns MSP recurring maintenance evidence tracking into a visible operating queue so every scheduled maintenance control has scoped execution evidence, reviewed exceptions, and a client-record outcome.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets MSP maintenance checklist, IT maintenance evidence, managed services runbook, and recurring IT task audit searches.

products.name: Ticket Escalation Handoff
products.product: A focused MSP ticket escalation handoff workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small managed service providers and multi-client IT support teams
products.problem: Escalated tickets lose diagnostic context and client promises when the next technician must reconstruct work from long comments, private chat, and monitoring alerts.
products.valueProposition: Turns MSP ticket escalation handoff into a visible operating queue so every escalation transfers a reproducible problem statement, completed diagnostics, client promise, and explicit acceptance by the next owner.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets MSP ticket escalation, IT support handoff template, help desk escalation process, and ticket escalation checklist searches.
